description: Current policy interest rates of major central banks (Fed, ECB, Bank of England, Bank of Japan, Bank of Canada, RBA, SNB, Riksbank, Norges Bank, RBNZ, CNB, NBP, RBI, BCB, Banxico, Bank of Korea, SARB, CBRT) with the date of the last change, the NEXT scheduled rate decision date from the official calendar, past decision outcomes (hike/cut/hold) and the latest monetary-policy press release. Refreshed daily from official feeds and several times on decision days. Use for 'when is the next Fed/ECB meeting', 'what did the ECB decide', 'current Bank of England rate'.

bank.description: Optional: bank or country (e.g. 'ECB', 'Fed', 'Bank of England', 'Japan', 'USA'). Omit for all banks.

days_ahead.description: Optional: only banks with a scheduled decision within this many days.

name: central_bank_rates
